    Lemma 12.3: the dimension count #

    The dimension part of lem:flat-mesh-perturbations over a field: the identities ZH = I, ZH_B ≥ I, the bound H_B ≤ H and the matrix argument (see FlatPerturbation.lean).

    theorem MultiplicativeBasisDeformations.FlatPert.finrank_alpha {k : Type u} [Field k] {V : Type} [Quiver V] [DecidableEq V] [(x y : V) → DecidableEq (x ⟶ y)] (J : IdealFam k V) [(x : V) → Fintype ((y : V) × (y ⟶ x))] [∀ (w y : V), FiniteDimensional k (Q J w y)] (w x : V) :
    Module.finrank k (Q J w x) = Module.finrank k ↥(alpha J w x).range + if w = x then 1 else 0

    theorem MultiplicativeBasisDeformations.FlatPert.matrix_arg {W : Type} [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W] (A R H HB : W → W → ℕ) (hC : ∀ (w x : W), ∑ y : W, R y x * H w y + H w x = ∑ y : W, A y x * H w y + if w = x then 1 else 0) (hB : ∀ (w x : W), (∑ y : W, A y x * HB w y + if w = x then 1 else 0) ≤ ∑ y : W, R y x * HB w y + HB w x) (hle : ∀ (w y : W), HB w y ≤ H w y) :
    HB = H ∧ ∀ (w x : W), (∑ y : W, A y x * HB w y + if w = x then 1 else 0) = ∑ y : W, R y x * HB w y + HB w x

    The matrix argument (deformation-refinements.tex): ZH = I, ZH_B ≥ I and H_B ≤ H force H_B = H and ZH_B = I.

    (LinearIndependent k fun (i : ι) => Submodule.Quotient.mk (LinearPaths.path (p i))) ∧ Submodule.span k (Set.range fun (i : ι) => Submodule.Quotient.mk (LinearPaths.path (p i))) = ⊤

    A path basis of C lifts to a basis of B when B and C have the same dimensions.

    theorem MultiplicativeBasisDeformations.FlatPert.flat_perturbation {k : Type u} [Field k] {V : Type} [Quiver V] [DecidableEq V] [(x y : V) → DecidableEq (x ⟶ y)] (P : Pres k V) [(x : V) → Fintype ((y : V) × (y ⟶ x))] (f : (x : V) → (t : P.T x) → Hm k (P.src x t) x) (hf : ∀ (x : V) (t : P.T x), f x t ∈ geSpan k (P.deg x t + 1) (P.src x t) x) (N : ℕ) [Fintype V] [(x y : V) → Fintype (x ⟶ y)] (hN : ∀ (w y : V) (p : Quiver.Path w y), N ≤ p.length → LinearPaths.path p ∈ ctxSpan P P.r w y) (hC : ∀ (w x : V), Function.Injective ⇑(relMap P (idealC P) P.r w x) ∧ (alpha (idealC P) w x).ker ≤ (relMap P (idealC P) P.r w x).range) :
    (∀ (w y : V), Module.finrank k (Q (idealB P f hf N) w y) = Module.finrank k (Q (idealC P) w y)) ∧ (∀ (w x : V), Function.Injective ⇑(relMap P (idealB P f hf N) (rf P f) w x) ∧ (alpha (idealB P f hf N) w x).ker ≤ (relMap P (idealB P f hf N) (rf P f) w x).range) ∧ ∀ (w y : V) {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] (p : ι → Quiver.Path w y), (LinearIndependent k fun (i : ι) => Submodule.Quotient.mk (LinearPaths.path (p i))) → Submodule.span k (Set.range fun (i : ι) => Submodule.Quotient.mk (LinearPaths.path (p i))) = ⊤ → (LinearIndependent k fun (i : ι) => Submodule.Quotient.mk (LinearPaths.path (p i))) ∧ Submodule.span k (Set.range fun (i : ι) => Submodule.Quotient.mk (LinearPaths.path (p i))) = ⊤

    Lemma 12.3 (lem:flat-mesh-perturbations): if the presentations of the simple modules of C = kQ/(r) are resolutions and C_d = 0 for d ≥ N, then B = kQ/(𝔪^{N+1}, r − f) has the dimensions of C, its presentations are again resolutions, and every path basis of C lifts to a basis of B.
